correctness.rationale: In the zero link, weight-two supports in a pairwise intersecting family of 2-sets form either a common-vertex star or the three edges of a triangle; adding weight-one vertices gives exactly the covered face types. The core built from the weight-one simplex, the bridge triangles and then the stars is contractible: each bridge attaches along one edge and each star intersects the previous union in a tree. Every triple triangle has its boundary in the core and its own interior; quotienting by the core gives one 2-sphere per triangle and the integral coefficient isomorphism on H₂. In particular the link H₃ vanishes. In the relative simplicial chains the faces containing zero are the suspended link chains (with the corresponding orientation convention). Each origin three-cube is an oriented crosspolytope boundary; its sixteen signed facets cancel on their common faces, and restricting to facets containing zero gives the octahedral link cycle with coefficient a unit on exactly its own triple triangle. Ordering its three nonzero-index antipodal pairs gives the sign of any coordinate permutation on the triple and no extra sign, yielding the integral equivariant right inverse. Hence the pair sequence gives the required injection and split surjection, including n=3. Multiplying the characteristic factors of the coordinate cycles gives binomial(f,3)−f c₂+c₃; every triple coefficient of an invariant is negated by an in-triple transposition. After equivariant barycentric subdivision the finite-group orbit cellular chains over Q are coinvariants, which agree with invariants by averaging, so the inclusion of orbit spaces induces the stated isomorphism. The supplied finite checker and EXPECTED.txt were inspected, not executed. In §2 the term ‘connecting homomorphism’ should read ‘natural map to relative homology followed by the link identification’; the arrow itself is correctly defined and used.

value.rationale: For a natural geometric deletion, the result identifies the effect in the integral lattice together with all stabilizer symmetries, where even rational decomposition data of the full cube alone are insufficient. The explicit cycles compute a primitive quotient and explain why the entire coordinate orbit space does not lose rational third homology although the punctured complex itself does. This is substantive information beyond the known ranks and ambient independent classes.
residual_risks: The value claim is limited to this single stabilizer and integral inclusion problem, not a general description of all subcomplexes or the full kernel representation.
